requirements.description: **api:** **Breaking change in a minor release.** A Live response's Decisions question `instructions` can now be a string or an array of text, image, or JSON parts. Code such as `question.instructions.trim()` can fail when it receives an array; check `typeof question.instructions === 'string'` and handle the array case. Decisions request inputs also accept new message roles and tool-history items, so update code that assumes it knows every input type. `DecisionInputMessage` is now a union: code that extends or implements the old interface must use `DecisionInputMessage.DecisionInputUserMessage` instead. Existing string instructions and user-message inputs still work.

**api:** expand Live Decision item and question types. **Breaking change in a minor release.** Live Decision item events now include messages and function/custom-tool calls and outputs. `DecisionItemCreatedEvent.item` and `DecisionItemCreateEvent.item` are unions, so callers that directly access `item.content` or `item.role` may no longer compile. For both event types, use `if ('content' in event.item)` before accessing message fields, and handle tool-item variants separately. Message items may omit `type`, so checking only `item.type === 'message'` can skip valid messages. This release also updates image-model documentation: `gpt-image-1` was shut down on October 23, 2026; replace explicit selections with `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.5-flare`. The documented default for Responses image-generation tools is now `gpt-image-2`; specify a supported model explicitly when you need a particular model.
